lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixels arranged in a grid of approximately six visible vertical columns and multiple horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal lines of blobs to form a regular coordinate-like system across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear ridges running horizontally across the upper flank, defined by high-luminance dorsal edges and low-luminance ventral shadows.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs localized within the visible anterior silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several remoras swimming in proximity to the ventral and posterior regions; a non-biological circular watermark is present in the upper right quadrant.
